cellacdc/shared/widgets.doc:
Widgets used by several program parts, by library modules or by plugins, grouped by theme (formerly widgets.py).

The package imports style.py, so the pyqtgraph setup (row-major images, colormap registry) runs before the body of any widget module, as importing widgets.py did.

- style.py: stylesheets, colors, font, colormap registries (cmaps, Gradients, custom colormaps).
- basic_widgets.py: separators, spacers, ScrollArea, labels, progress bars, log console.
- push_buttons.py: PushButton and the icon buttons, getPushButton, Toggle, myColorButton.
- message_box.py: myMessageBox and its content helpers.
- line_edits.py: validated and numeric line edits, path controls, formWidget, shortcut text conversion.
- numeric_inputs.py: SpinBox, DoubleSpinBox, sliders, scroll bars, RangeSelector.
- combo_boxes.py: ComboBox and other combo boxes, PreProcessingSelector.
- item_views.py: QDialogListbox, listWidget, TreeWidget.
- search_widgets.py: ButtonSearchWidget and the fuzzy search helpers.
- lut_items.py: histogram LUT items and colormap menus.
- plot_items.py: pyqtgraph plot, image and graphics items.
- toolbars.py: ToolBar with overflow shortcuts, OverlayToolbar, tool buttons.
- imshow_window.py: the image preview window of imshow in plot.py.

Dialog modules import widget modules at module level. Three widget modules import dialog modules at module level too: combo_boxes.py (shared/dialogs/generic.py and preprocessing.py), line_edits.py and lut_items.py (shared/dialogs/generic.py). These import cycles are safe because the dialogs are used only at call time through the module alias (dialogs_generic.QInput), never through a from-import of a name. The other widget modules import no dialog module at module level.

cellacdc/gui/widgets.doc:
Widgets used only by the main GUI window (gui/main_window/), never by the measurements viewer. Widgets that the viewer-shared mixins reach are in gui/mixins/widgets.py.

- edit_toolbars.py: editing toolbars (manual tracking, merge and whitelist IDs, separate bud, edit ID, ...).
- main_window_items.py: ghost items, brush circle, delete ROI, log widget and other window parts.
- points_layer_widgets.py: points layers and magic prompts toolbars and items.

cellacdc/shared/widgets/basic_widgets.py.doc: Basic building blocks used by every program part: separators (QHLine, QVLine, VerticalResizeHline), spacers (QHWidgetSpacer, QVWidgetSpacer), ScrollArea, labels (QClickableLabel, Label, AutoGrowFixedSizeLabel, statusBarPermanentLabel), progress bars (ProgressBar, ProgressBarWithETA), the log console (QLogConsole), the loading animation (LoadingCircleAnimation), CheckableWidget, DummyWidget and MouseCursor.

cellacdc/shared/widgets/push_buttons.py.doc:
PushButton and its whole family of icon buttons (okPushButton, cancelPushButton, savePushButton, infoPushButton, ...).

load.py's get_all_buttons_names finds the button classes with a regex on this file (every `class X(PushButton)`), so keep all of them here, also those with a single user. Also here: getPushButton (picks the icon button for a button text, used by myMessageBox and QDialogListbox: word button texts by its keywords), browseFileButton, showDetailsButton, CancelOkButtonsLayout, the Toggle switch, ToggleTerminalButton, expandCollapseButton, ToggleVisibilityButton, ToggleVisibilityCheckBox, myColorButton (pyqtgraph color button with sigColorRejected) and FeatureSelectorButton. Several buttons are subclassed by spotMAX.

cellacdc/shared/widgets/message_box.py.doc:
myMessageBox, the standard Cell-ACDC message box, with its content helpers (LabelsWidget, LatexLabel, CopiableCommandWidget, addWidgetToScrollArea) and the Visual C++ prerequisite warning (warnVisualCppRequired, view_visualcpp_screenshot, used by the YeastMate model).

Tests patch myMessageBox in this module, so callers look it up here at call time (widgets_message_box.myMessageBox), never through a from-import. Button texts get their icon from getPushButton in push_buttons.py.

cellacdc/shared/widgets/line_edits.py.doc:
Text inputs.

- Validated line edits: ValidLineEdit, ElidingLineEdit, alphaNumericLineEdit, LineEdit and the FloatLineEdit / IntLineEdit / VectorLineEdit family (shared invalid-entry stylesheet from style.py).
- File and folder path controls with recent paths: filePathControl, FolderPathControl, CsvFilePathControl.
- Labelled form rows: formWidget, FormLayout.
- Keyboard shortcuts: ShortcutLineEdit, KeySequenceFromText, QKeyEventToString, macShortcutToWindows, windowsShortcutToMac, modifierKeyToText. Tests simulate macOS by patching is_mac in this module.

cellacdc/shared/widgets/numeric_inputs.p.doc: Numeric value controls: SpinBox and DoubleSpinBox (with the temporary focus change check _isTemporaryFocusChange), OddSpinBox, read-only spin boxes (readOnlySpinbox, readOnlyDoubleSpinbox), sliderWithSpinBox, the ScrollBar family (labelledQScrollbar, ScrollBarWithNumericControl) and RangeSelector. Leaf module: it imports no other widget module.

cellacdc/shared/widgets/combo_boxes.py.doc: Combo boxes: ComboBox (sigTextChanged and previousText(), used by the mode selector of the GUI), QCenteredComboBox, AlphaNumericComboBox, TypableComboBox, font size selection (FontSizeCombobox, FontSizeQMenu), scatter symbol pickers (pgScatterSymbolsCombobox, VisPyMarkersSymbolsCombobox), PreProcessingSelector (choice and parameters of preprocessing recipe steps) and YeazV2SelectModelNameCombobox.

cellacdc/shared/widgets/item_views.py.doc: Lists and trees: QDialogListbox (the list selection dialog; pass allowEmptySelection=False wherever an answer is required), listWidget with rich-text items (RichTextListWidgetItem, _RichTextItemEventFilter), TreeWidget, TreeWidgetItem and readOnlyQList.

cellacdc/shared/widgets/search_widgets.p.doc: Search widgets: ButtonSearchWidget (finds the buttons, actions and measurements of a window), the fuzzy-matching proxy models ButtonSearchCompleter and MeasurementTreeSearchProxy, the highlight delegate _ButtonSearchHighlightDelegate (subclassed by the measurements viewer) and the text matching helpers (_fuzzySearchSimilarity, _searchSynonyms, _matchesSearchText, _normalizeSearchText, _searchHighlightRanges, _highlightSearchText). Leaf module: it imports no other widget module.

cellacdc/shared/widgets/lut_items.py.doc: Histogram LUT items and colormap widgets: baseHistogramLUTitem and myHistogramLUTitem (image and overlay LUTs with the colormap menu, see the LUT spec in gui/mixins/navigation.py), the labels colormap widgets (BaseLabelsGradientWidget, labelsGradientWidget), the gradient editor items that swap in the colormap registries of style.py (BaseGradientEditorItemImage, BaseGradientEditorItemLabels), the custom colormap menu action (CustomGradientMenuAction), FilterObject and highlightableQWidgetAction.

cellacdc/shared/widgets/plot_items.py.doc: pyqtgraph plot, image and graphics items shared by the main GUI, the measurements viewer, data prep and the image preview window: MainPlotItem, BaseImageItem, ParentImageItem, labImageItem, BaseLabelsImageItem, PlotCurveItem, MirroredCursorItem, RulerPlotItem, RectItem and MouseMoveTrailingEdgeFilter, plus ContourItem, ScatterPlotItem (subclassed by spotMAX), PolyLineROI and FadingTrackItem. Leaf module: it imports no other widget module.

cellacdc/shared/widgets/toolbars.py.doc: ToolBar with the overflow shortcuts of buttons that a too narrow toolbar hides (_ToolBarOverflowShortcut, _isHiddenByOverflow, updateToolbarsOverflowShortcuts), ToolBarSeparator, OverlayToolbar, CheckableAction and the shared tool buttons (rightClickToolButton, ToolButtonCustomColor, GradientToolButton, PointsLayerToolButton, OverlayChannelToolButton).

cellacdc/shared/widgets/imshow_window.py.doc: The image preview window of imshow in plot.py (ImShow, QBaseWindow, ImShowPlotItem, _ImShowImageItem), also opened by the segmentation module, askZPlaneView and the data structure previews. plot.py imports this module at module level under if GUI_INSTALLED, so plot.py stays importable without Qt.

cellacdc/gui/mixins/widgets.py.doc:
Widgets reached from the GUI mixins that the measurements viewer also composes, so changing them affects both windows.

- Navigation (gui/mixins/navigation.py): navigateQScrollBar, linkedQScrollbar, SwitchPlaneCombobox.
- Overlay (gui/mixins/overlay.py): overlayLabelsGradientWidget, OverlayImageItem.
- Viewer tools and object info (gui/mixins/viewer_tools.py, gui/mixins/object_info.py): ScaleBar, TimestampItem, LabelItem, ROI, ZoomROI, the object properties tab guiTabControl with its group boxes (PixelSizeGroupbox, objPropsQGBox, objIntesityMeasurQGBox).
- Custom annotations (gui/mixins/custom_annotations.py): CustomAnnotToolButton, BaseScatterPlotItem, CustomAnnotationScatterPlotItem.
- Annotations (gui/mixins/annotations.py): CheckBox.
- Timestamp properties dialog (gui/mixins/dialogs.py): FontSizeWidget, TimeWidget and its sign_int_mapper.

Widgets used only by the main GUI window are in gui/widgets/.

cellacdc/gui/widgets/edit_toolbars.py.doc: Editing toolbars of the main GUI window (never the measurements viewer): manual tracking, copy lost object, clear region, manual background, whitelist IDs, merge IDs, brush strokes cell selection, highlighted ID, magic wand controls, separate bud, export current view and edit ID toolbars, with the ID line edits (KeepIDsLineEdit, IDsLineEdit), KeptObjectIDsList and ToolButtonTextIcon.

cellacdc/gui/widgets/main_window_items.p.doc: Graphics items and window parts of the main GUI window only: the ghost contour and mask of objects being moved (GhostContourItem, GhostMaskItem), the brush circle (LabelRoiCircularItem, with the clipSelemMask helper), the delete ROI (DelROI), ChildImageItem, myLabelItem, GroupBox, the central widget (GuiCentralWidget), FireworksOverlay and the log widget (XStream, QLog, QtHandler).

cellacdc/gui/widgets/points_layer_widget.doc: Points layers and promptable model (magic prompts) widgets of the main GUI window only: PointsLayersToolbar, PromptableModelPointsLayerToolbar, MagicPromptsToolbar, SavePointsLayerButton, PointsScatterPlotItem, the box prompt ROI (PromptBoxROI, _PromptBoxHandle) and SamInputPointsWidget. The points layer dialogs are in gui/dialogs/points_layers.py, the window methods in gui/main_window/points_layers.py.

notes: Source: final widgets design (agent a4ef68c4638f7df74) with the synthesis corrections. R3: the design's pg_setup.py is renamed shared/widgets/style.py and gets ALL module-level state of widgets.py (pyqtgraph row-major config, stylesheets/colors, font, custom_cmaps_filepath, str_to_operator_mapper, nonInvertibleCmaps, the renamePgCmaps()/removeHSVcmaps() calls, cmaps/Gradients/GradientsLabels/GradientsImage), not basic_widgets.py as the consistency check proposed. R3/R14: sign_int_mapper, FontSizeWidget and TimeWidget go to gui/mixins/widgets.py (the design had FontSizeWidget/TimeWidget in gui/mixins/dialogs.py).

Coverage: all 301 non-import top-level statements of widgets.py at 4c4e498b are mapped (282 defs + 16 assignments + 3 expression statements). The key 'cmaps' is the tuple assignment `cmaps, Gradients = addGradients()`, so Gradients also lives in style.py. No import of widgets.py has a side effect that must be kept (no 'import:' items): `from . import apps` is dropped, and its 8 uses become function-level imports (filePathControl.browseRecentPaths and ExportCurrentViewToolbar.selectDstFromRecentPaths -> SearchableListboxDialog, baseHistogramLUTitem._askNameColormap and BaseLabelsGradientWidget._askNameColormap -> QInput, YeazV2SelectModelNameCombobox.onTextChanged -> QLineEditDialog, SavePointsLayerButton.renameTable -> filenameDialog, PreProcessingSelector.askSetParams -> FunctionParamsDialog, MagicPromptsToolbar._selectModel -> SelectPromptableModelDialog). Widget modules never import dialog modules at module level.

Eager setup: cellacdc/shared/widgets/__init__.py must contain `from . import style  # noqa: F401` after its docstring (the packages entry gives only the docstring). Python runs the package __init__ before any submodule, so the colormap registry is patched before any widget module body runs, as importing widgets.py did. style.py imports no other widget module. The idempotent `pg.setConfigOption('imageAxisOrder', 'row-major')` statement is mapped to style.py; copying it into other modules that use pg is up to the tool.

Read the mutable/redirected globals through the module at call time: custom_cmaps_filepath (readers: getCustomGradients in style.py, baseHistogramLUTitem, BaseLabelsGradientWidget, labelsGradientWidget in lut_items.py) must be read as widgets_style.custom_cmaps_filepath so that the conftest isolation (add it to USER_SETTINGS_PATHS) reaches every reader. Gradients, GradientsLabels and GradientsImage must stay the same dict objects (pyqtgraph's Gradients is mutated in place; the gradient editor items swap them in). No item of widgets.py uses `global`.

Relative imports inside moved bodies must become absolute: ImShow._get2DlabContoursOverlay `from . import regionprops` (widgets.py line 10320) and ImShow.showImages `from .plot import matplotlib_cmap_to_lut` (line 10625; `plot` is a local variable there and in autoRange) -> imshow_window.py; the SignalProcessingSelector class body `from .measurement_processing import MEASUREMENT_PROCESSING_MAPPER as preprocessMapper` (line 13119) -> measurements_viewer/dialogs/processing_recipe.py. The absolute in-body imports of YeazV2SelectModelNameCombobox (cellacdc.models._yeaz_v2_weights) are unchanged.

Import-time edges between new modules (class bases and one annotation), all pointing to lower layers: gui/widgets/* -> shared/widgets/{line_edits,toolbars,plot_items} and gui/mixins/widgets.py (PromptBoxROI(ROI)); gui/mixins/widgets.py -> shared/widgets/{toolbars,numeric_inputs}; toolbars.py -> lut_items.py (OverlayChannelToolButton's myHistogramLUTitem argument annotation; lut_items.py never references toolbars.py, so a plain module-level import is acyclic; the design's alternative is `from __future__ import annotations` + TYPE_CHECKING); utils/base.py -> item_views.py (OrderableList(listWidget)); data_structure/dialogs/metadata.py -> message_box.py (installJavaDialog(myMessageBox)); gui/dialogs/segmentation.py -> item_views.py (selectTrackerGUI(QDialogListbox)); measurements_viewer/dialogs/processing_recipe.py -> combo_boxes.py (SignalProcessingSelector(PreProcessingSelector)); shared/dialogs/model_params.py -> numeric_inputs.py (PostProcessSegmSlider(sliderWithSpinBox)); shared/dialogs/generic.py -> search_widgets.py (_RecentItemsSearchCompleter(ButtonSearchCompleter)). Runtime-only cycle push_buttons.py <-> message_box.py (getPushButton / infoPushButton.show_info): module-alias access only.

Modules first created in C5 by items of this shard but documented by other shards (no doc/alias given here): apps shard: shared/dialogs/generic.py, model_selection.py, model_params.py, set_measurements.py, gui/dialogs/segmentation.py, data_io.py, points_layers.py, data_structure/dialogs/metadata.py, setup.py, launcher/dialogs.py; viewer shard: measurements_viewer/widgets.py (MeasurementTreeModel), measurements_viewer/dialogs/processing_recipe.py (SignalProcessingSelector). So C5 also needs the packages cellacdc/shared, cellacdc/shared/dialogs, cellacdc/gui/dialogs, cellacdc/data_structure/dialogs and cellacdc/measurements_viewer/dialogs (owned by the moves/apps/viewer shards) unless they exist earlier. The modules entries for the existing modules utils/base.py, utils/fromImageJroiToSegm.py, utils/generateMothBudTotalTable.py are alias proposals (between C5 and C6 apps.py reaches OrderableListWidget, OrderableList, PrefixFilenameLineEdit, RescaleImageJroisGroupbox and get_min_width_for_no_scrollbar through them); volume_renderer/_widgets.py gets alias `_widgets`, the name its only user volume_renderer/canvas.py already binds.

Coordination with the apps shard: apps.py's TREEWIDGET_STYLESHEET, LISTWIDGET_STYLESHEET and LINEEDIT_WARNING_STYLESHEET are byte-identical duplicates of widgets.py lines 93-96 (same _palettes calls); apps.json maps them to shared/widgets/style.py too (R3) and asks the move tool to merge them with the identical bindings placed here in C5 (one binding each), not to paste a second copy. If the tool cannot merge, map them to DELETE in apps.json and let their readers use widgets_style.X.

Other C5 edits outside the mapping (synthesis C5 row and widgets design risks): load.get_all_buttons_names reads shared/widgets/push_buttons.py (all 61 regex-matched button classes are there); _view_all_buttons.py uses push_buttons; plot.py's `if GUI_INSTALLED: from . import widgets` becomes a function-level import of imshow_window inside plot.imshow; volume_renderer/canvas.py evaluates 6 dataclass annotations at import (baseHistogramLUTitem, sliderWithSpinBox, OverlayChannelToolButton, PointsLayerToolButton, PointsLayerContextMenu, apps.EditPointsLayerAppearanceDialog). String annotations naming widgets: apps.py 'widgets.PreProcessingSelector', load.py 'widgets.PlotCurveItem'. Tests: getattr(widgets, cls) in tests/test_keep_ids.py (KeepIDsLineEdit, IDsLineEdit -> edit_toolbars; SpinBox, DoubleSpinBox -> numeric_inputs); patches of widgets.myMessageBox -> message_box, widgets.is_mac -> line_edits (read there by windowsShortcutToMac; also read by myMessageBox, myHistogramLUTitem and installJavaDialog in their own modules), widgets._fuzzySearchSimilarity -> search_widgets, widgets.selectTrackerGUI -> gui/dialogs/segmentation.py; tests/test_list_selection_required.py walks the directory of widgets.__file__.

Layering check done on the base code (AST scan of every reference to a widgets.py name in cellacdc/, users mapped to their new modules through the apps/workers/myutils/gui/viewer designs): nothing placed in gui/widgets/* is used outside the guiWin-only modules, nothing placed in gui/mixins/widgets.py is used by shared or library code, and every part placement has users only in its part (PointsLayerContextMenu: volume_renderer/canvas.py only). spotMAX-used names (PushButton family, TreeWidget, QClickableLabel, IntLineEdit, ScatterPlotItem, PointsLayerToolButton, ...) are all in shared/widgets.
